test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

Some pens are sketch pens.

All sketch pens are erasers.

Some erasers are rulers.

Conclusions:

(I) Some rulers are sketch pens.

(II) Some erasers are pens.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dde207c742cc8f53739916120a57cfcf845328d2b15c9bfea5f5cff75622b57f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94b6de9edf6156259a6618ba074c8f7f8fecf40aa8383364afac9751859ccab2.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some rulers are sketch pens → Does not follow (As some erasers are rulers and all sketch pens are erasers. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) Some erasers are pens → Follow (As some pens are sketch pens, all sketch pens are erasers and some erasers are rulers. As some part of pens is common with sketch pens which whole comes in erasers, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
